title: Phantomanta
description: Transforms phantoms into manta rays that attack from the murky depths below.
body:
*Beware what lurks in the deep!*

![A player, equipped with a trident, faces off against three phantoms in the Warm Ocean biome. Above them is the title "Phantomanta" stylized in all caps in a pixelated font. Below it is a subtitle that says "noun" in italics. At the very bottom of the image, below the player and the phantoms, a second subtitle says "Where it should have been to begin with."](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9fecc2e76685b43194f9de6ea68080fd6836f1d.jpeg)

**Phantomanta** transforms the normally airborne phantoms into manta rays that attack you from the murky depths below.

This is a relatively minor behavioral change to the pre-existing Phantom mob:
- Phantoms will now spawn exclusively under the water.
- They will hang around seagrass and kelp, circling around in the same way they usually do in midair. 
- Phantoms will jump out of the water to attack players if within aggro distance.
- If above-ground for too long, Phantoms will fall back into the water.

This mod is pretty simple and bare-bones, so I will do my best to port it to a few versions, but no promises!

This mod was made as a project for [Mogswamp](https://www.youtube.com/@Mogswamp)!
